answer_result.answer: Dave finds restoring old cars satisfying because it feels like bringing something back to life. He loves transforming something old, broken-down, or beat-up into something beautiful or awesome, and he describes the result as worth the hard work. He also says it gives him a sense of accomplishment, pride, and fulfillment; it is therapeutic and relaxing, an escape from everyday stress, and a way to connect back with himself. He notes that restoration takes patience and attention to detail, but the payoff is worth it.
